title: A sighting (one row of research/coverage/record/sightings.jsonl)
description: A component type seen alive on one side: first in the record (sighted), or again in a later capture of a run (repeated). Written by RecordBook.Sightings and the replays.

instance.description: The game copy; `installed` for the installed game.

role.description: Who wrote it; `unknown` when nobody said.

stretch.description: The stretch of the run; `unknown` when nobody said.

level.description: The level it was seen in; absent when not known.

label.description: The capture's label; absent when it had none.

capture.description: instance@start#tag of the capture that wrote it; `replay` for a row written by a passing replay.
